svg.title: A coefficient cocycle deletes off-diagonal generator blocks
svg.desc: Relative to a projection q, the generator H has four blocks. The bounded selfadjoint K equals i times the commutator of delta q with q. Adding K deletes H's two off-diagonal blocks. The cocycle solving u prime equals i u alpha t K gives the exterior-equivalent action fixing q. In the two by two example the generator in q's adapted basis is the matrix with off-diagonal entries one and diagonal zero; K is its negative and H plus K is zero.
svg.metadata: Original CC0 diagram. Proposition 1.3 and Example 1.4. Human source: Connes, Survey of foliations and operator algebras, Section 13, first lemma, p. 39.
svg.text: Fixing a projection by correcting one real generator
u′t = i ut αt(K), u₀ = 1, uₛ₊t = uₛ αₛ(ut)
Example 1.4, in q’s adapted basis: H = [0 1; 1 0], K = −H, H + K = 0.
Norm-convergent Volterra series gives a unitary cocycle in the coefficient algebra.
